data_description.idle_timeout: Keeping the link open makes changes instant but blocks the phone app and uses a proxy connection slot.
data_description.gamma: WS2812 LEDs are linear, so mixed colors look washed out compared to the color picker. 2.2-2.8 makes them closer to what you picked (orange looks orange instead of yellow). Applies to static colors only.
